| **Frequent Asked Questions**<br>============================ |
| * * * |     |

        **![](https://solucionesid.com/ckfinder/userfiles/agencia806/img_meridalife/original1.jpg) ![](https://solucionesid.com/ckfinder/userfiles/agencia806/img_meridalife/original2.jpg) ![](https://solucionesid.com/ckfinder/userfiles/agencia806/img_meridalife/original3.jpg)**

**Is it safe to own a home in Yucatan and leave it unoccupied for part of the year if I am unable to rent it?**

The Yucatan is very, very safe, and we see few break-ins.  It is unlikely that your property would suffer  any damage of any kind.  Insurance is also available and inexpensive.

I**s Merida Safe?**

Violent crimes in Mexico are very rare and Merida and the Yucatan are considered by most people to be one of the safest places on earth to live. In Merida, you can walk down any street in Centro day or night without worrying about purse snatching or muggings.

WHY? First there is a different philosophy of law and order. The Mexican approach is based on the Napoleonic Code rather than English Common Law. Therefore, instead of being innocent until proven guilty, a person must prove their innocence or take the penalty. Thus, people in Mexico tend to be more careful and concerned in their dealings with others and in their behavior.

A second factor (especially in the Yucatan) is that it is primarily a family and community oriented society and there is very little juvenile crime and delinquency. For example: on weekends, instead of the youth driving around, drinking and looking for trouble; they go to many of Merida´s town squares with their parents and family. In Merida, you can see teenagers escorting their Grandparents and even dancing with them in the Zocolo.

In addition, neighbors (both Mexican and foreigner) watch out for each other and keep an eye on each other´s property while they are away from home.

**EAT THE FOOD WITHOUT GETTING SICK?**

In Merida, you can find a wide variety of restaurants from fast food to five star. Merida also has a huge number of street vendors…all of which are safe. However, we would recommend you drinking bottled water.

Merida has a large variety of grocery stores and many local market places with a pretty large selection of fresh fruits, vegetables and produce that truly make shopping a lovely experience. The Mexican climate provides year round growing so that berries, melons, mangos, pineapples, avocados, bananas, lettuce, squash, etc. are picked for the market when fresh and are delicious.

**ARE THERE SOME GOOD VETS?**

Dogs and cats with a veterinarian´s certificate indicating updated immunizations can be brought into Mexico without any quarantine. The vets in are all well trained, inexpensive and even make house calls at no added cost. We would be more than happy to give you some phone numbers of confident vets.

**WHY IS MERIDA CALLED THE WHITE CITY**

There are probably three reasons why it is called the White City: (1) the inhabitants generally wear white guayaberas, huipilles and Panama hats, (2) there is a white lime mixture that is used to spread on most of the roof tops to make them watertight and (3) the cleanliness of the city. The streets, plazas and parks are generally cleaned every day.

**THE HISTORY OF MERIDA?**

Merida, the colonial capital of the Yucatan was founded by Francisco de Montejo (a Spaniard) in 1542. When the Spanish arrived, they conquered the Mayan city of T´ho or Ichcansiho, tore down the pyramids and used the huge stones to build the foundation for the Cathedral of San Idelfonso. The Spaniards enslaved the Indians and built grand houses, offices and cathedrals. Merida became the capital, trade center and seat of civil and religious authority of the Peninsula. The Indians finally rebelled in the 1840´s ( the Caste War).

**WHAT IS MERIDA LIKE TODAY?**

Merida today has about 1,100,000 residents and is a very cosmopolitan city with Mayan and Spanish descendants and is an extremely cultural city with many museums, libraries, theaters, numerous universities, etc. The economy that was once based on the henequen industry is now based on tourism, agriculture and fishing plus Merida´s export business is increasing every day. Some of the items exported are honey, sisal rope, petroleum products, hammocks, fine jewelry, concentrated orange juice, fish etc.

Residents call Merida "the Paris of the West" because of it´s tree lined boulevards, colonial mansions and estates of the henequen barons of the 1800¨s. There are many things to see in and around Merida. It is an easy drive from Merida to beaches, Mayan ruins, haciendas, etc. One of the nicest things about Merida is its people. The Yucatecan people are hospitable, honest, easygoing, hard working and make wonderful neighbors.

**GOOD MEDICAL AND DENTAL FACILITIES?**

YES! Merida has numerous hospitals that are staffed by well trained physicians, most of whom were trained in the United States. The hospitals in Merida are considered among the best in Mexico. Wonderful, inexpensive dental work is also available in Merida. Many Americans and Canadians have been taking advantage of this for years. Also within the past five years, a growing number of Americans and Canadians have been coming to Merida for plastic surgery. We would be more than happy to refer you to competent doctors, dentists and plastic surgeons in Merida.

**HOW MUCH SHOULD I TIP?**

Tipping varies from place to place and depending on what the services is, the following is a general rule to follow:

*   Restaurants…15%
*   hotel and guest house help…. at least 10 pesos ($1 US) per day
*   Strolling musicians…. 40 to 50 pesos
*   Parking attendants….. 5 to 6 pesos
*   Bag boys and girls at the grocery store…. 5 to 6 pesos
*   Gas station attendants….. 5 to 6 pesos….YES, gas stations are still full service in Merida
*   Extra tips for exceptional service are always welcomed and appreciated

| WELCOME TO "BUYING IN MEXICO" A BUYERS GUIDE TO INFORMATION<br>=========================================================== |
| * * * |     |

            ![](https://media.point2.com/p2a/htmltext/e09b/b51f/07c9/a9b2938eacfb924915d7/original.jpg)

**FAQ about Buying and Owning**

**Real Estate in Mexico**

Some Americans, Canadians and foreigners believe that ownership of Mexican real estate is difficult, unsafe, or both. This is simply not true.

  

Mexico's long-established Foreign Investment Law allows non-Mexicans to acquire coastal and border property through bank trusts that are held by a Mexican bank. Under this secure ownership mechanism, the bank holds the deed to the real estate for you. The term of a Mexican real estate bank trust is 50 years, renewable for additional 50 year periods.

  

This bank trust mechanism was designed to provide

  

With a Mexican real estate bank trust your Mexican real erstate is not part of the bank's assets and cannot be subject to lien, or attached to bank obligations. The trust is not a lease, and you have all ownership rights to the property. Properties do not pass back to the Mexican government at the end of the trust period -- a occasional misconception and unfounded fear of purchasers from the United States and Canada.

  

**Mayan World Real Estate** has relationships with the best trust-specialists in YUCATAN State, and our track record of successful transactions and happy clients attests to the security of this mechanism.

  

We hope that this FAQ about Mexican real estate ownership is helpful to you.

  

We encourage you to contact us for additional information regarding the ownership of Mexican real estate by non-Mexicans, and how **Mayan World Real Estate** can help make your home ownership dream secure not only for you, but for your children and grandchildren!

  

Consider the wonderful lifestyle and economic advantages of Mexican property ownership!

  

1.  **Are non-Mexicans able to own real estate in Mexico? The answer is YES!** It is a common misconception that foreigners cannot own Real Estate in Mexico; in realty it's possible to do so. However, there is a "restricted zone", as described below. Properties anywhere outside the restricted zone can be owned on a fee-simple basis; foreign (non-Mexican) ownership of property is both legal and common. An alternative form of ownership is to purchase non-residential property through a Mexican corporation. Corporations can be, under certain conditions, 100% foreign-owned, if there is a provision in the by-laws that the foreigners agree to subject themselves to Mexican law, refusing possible invocation of laws of other countries.  Another requirement is that the real estate acquired under a Mexican Corporation has been registered with the Foreign Affairs Ministry, and is used for non-residential activities. In other words, under said conditions, foreigners can acquire, directly, properties destined for tourist, commercial and industrial use, even inside the restricted zone. For residential purposes inside the Restricted Zone, ownership through a bank trust is required.
    
  
3.  **Where is Mexico's "restricted zone"?**  The "restricted zone" is defined as any real estate that is within 30.5 miles (50 kilometers) of Mexico's coast, or within 61 miles (100 kilometers) of Mexico's borders with other nations (Guatemala, Belize and the USA). Within this zone non-Mexicans can own real estate, but are required by Mexico's Foreign Investment Law to do so through a bank trust.  
    
  
5.  **Why did Mexico establish the restricted zone?**  The restricted zone is enshrined in Article 27 of the Mexican Constitution, and was designed to protect Mexico from possible invasions. While this is certainly a remote possibility today, it is important to remember that Mexico has experienced several invasions, wars, and tremendous losses of territory in its history;  the restricted zone is really nothing more than a legacy of that history. From the non-Mexican investor's perspective, the important thing to remember is that Mexico's Foreign Investment Law was designed to facilitate the safe acquisition of coastal and border properties by non-Mexicans, and specifically designed to protect the rights of foreign owners. 
    
  
7.  **What is a Bank Trust?**  A bank trust, or "fiedicomiso" in Spanish, is similar in structure to a trust in the United States.  The trustee is a bank, protected under financial laws, and the beneficiary can be any individual, partnership, limited liability company or corporation, Mexican or non-Mexican (which can also be useful tools for Estate Planning).
    
  
9.  **Is a Mexico Bank Trust a form of Lease? No.**   A bank trust is not a lease, and confers on the trust-holder the same rights as "ownership" in the United States or Canada.
    
  
11.  **Are Mexican Real Estate Bank Trusts safe? Yes!**   The bank simply holds the deed to the property for you or your assignees and beneficiaries.  Major International banks such as Banco Monex, Banco Interacciones, ScotiaBank Inverlat, GE Capital, and Santander Serfin, among many, are very active in the bank trust market. Your property is not part of the bank's assets, and cannot be subject to bankruptcy, lien, or attached in any way to bank obligations. As the beneficiary to a bank trust, the property owner has the exclusive ability to make all decisions and to direct all actions regarding the property.  The property can be bought and sold, bequeathed and inherited, etc. ONLY with the direction of the trust beneficiary.  For over 35 years bank trusts have proven themselves secure for more than 1.5 million Americans and Canadians who are now enjoying the lifestyle and financial benefits of Mexican property ownership.
    
  
13.  **Will I be able to will my property in Mexico to my children and grandchildren? Yes.**   The most common and longest term for a trust is 50 years, renewable for additional 50 year period. In fact, trusts are renewable at any time by simple application. It was never the intent that trust-held properties pass to the government at the end of the trust period, which has been a common misconception of purchasers from the United States and Canada. What happens after 100 years?  A new bank trust will be formed to hold the assets for another 50 years, and same rules will apply.
    
  
15.  **We have been told that a "Notario" will be involved in our purchase and title process. What is a Notario?**   The Notario Publico is a government appointed lawyer who processes and certifies all real estate and corporate transactions.  The Notario is ultimately responsible to the government for the collection of all taxes involved.  It is extremely important to remember that a Notario cannot represent you in your real estate transaction; he may offer advice, but he does not, and can not, "represent" you.  
    
  
17.  **How can I learn more about buying real estate in Mexico?**   **Mayan World Real Estate** is always happy to answer questions regarding Mexican real estate ownership. Always remember that Mexico wants its non-Mexican real estate owners to feel completely secure that their investment in Mexico is as safe as their real estate holdings in their home countries. With just a small amount of prudent effort at the start of your journey into Mexican real estate, your ownership of part of Mexico's magnificent coast will be simple and safe!
    
  
19.  **Are there Title Processing Companies in Mexico as in the USA? Yes.** There are some reputable companies who offer escrow and closing services, as well as US Title Insurance policies to protect your investment. Contact a reputable Realtor to learn more about which is the best to use in the area you are considering a purchase.

### Property description

Mayan World Real Estate presents " EXCLUSIVE TURN KEY 2 BEDROOM 2 BATHROOM CONDO WITH SOLAR PANELS" in Progreso, Yucatan.

Progreso is located 30 km from Mérida. It is the first and most important port on the Yucatecan coast. It has all the natural elements for practicing different activities and has become a tourist center.

Its beaches have white sand, are not very deep and the waves are calm and without currents, which makes it an ideal place to practice various water sports such as windsurfing, kayaking, sailing, swimming, paddle boarding and many others.

### Property description

Mayan World Real Estate presents "CASA LA GRINGA" 150mts from the Beach in Chicxulub Puerto. Km. 12.

In this beautiful port, the main economic activity is fishing, however, it is a tradition for Chicxulub to receive local and foreign vacationers during Easter and the summer season, which is why it has become an important tourist attraction in the region.

The main avenue that connects with the port of Progreso has restaurants and food stores, stores that open up during the holiday season along with the area of ​​clubs and bars.

An important activity is the port fair that is set up in the main park and can be enjoyed by the family. It has mechanical games, food stands and sales of various products of interest. You can also go to the pier very early to fish with your friends or family. Don't forget to bring your bait!!

La Mejorada neighborhood has taken on a new life: restaurants and bars with Yucatecan and international specialties, cultural centers, museums, public offices, music schools and university schools turn this corner of the city into a cultural neighborhood with its own personality and identity.

Within the neighborhood you can find the Museo de Arte Popular, the Centro Cultural del Niño Yucateco, the Museo de la Canción Yucateca, the Facultad de Arquitectura de la UADY; also, in the central part of the square you will find a monument dedicated to the child heroes who defended Chapultepec Castle during the American invasion.

**FEATURES**

This lovely house has a very good location since it is a few steps from the Parque de la Mejorada, a block and a half from the Palacio de Musica, three blocks from the famous La Chaya Maya restaurant and 4 blocks from the Teatro Armando Manzanero.

You can turn it into a Boutique Hotel, a Gallery, a Restaurant or a Beautiful House to live in.

On the ground floor there is the Hall, the Kitchen, 3 Bedrooms, half bathroom and a very large central patio.

On the upper floor there are 3 Bedrooms and 2 Bathrooms.

Great Balcony and two awnings.

It has original pasta tile floors, colonial wooden doors and high ceilings which provide a natural freshness inside the property

It is built with unique architectural and ornamental details, its central courtyard inside offers an oasis of tranquility in the middle of the city. In addition, the architecture of the house is designed to take full advantage of natural ventilation, keeping the interiors cool.

The house is working in order and in very good condition. It only needs to be adapted for the business you want to have.

In front of the property there is a public parking lot where guests can leave their car.

Close your Eyes and Imagine your perfect house in Cholul area.

The town of Cholul is located 11 kilometers northeast of the downtown of the city of Mérida. 3 km from Altabrisa Mall.

The property is located in downtown of Cholul, two blocks from several mini-supermarkets, a market, pharmacies, an ATM, tortilla shops, hardware stores, a pizzeria, cafes, restaurants, a bakery, a stationery store, and other businesses. It is also two blocks from the park and the church.

Away from the noise near everything.

**3 properties in one with 2 lofts and house on land of 1000 square meters and pool.**  
 

The perfect property to have a rental income around $3,000 USD monthly

**FEATURES**

Excellent property with 990 m2 of land with fruit trees such as tamarind, plums, and mangoes.

\*\*\* The Ground Floor is a small house of 150 meters2, with 2 Bedrooms and 2 Bathrooms (Master with Bath Tub and Walk - in Closet), Living room, Dining room, Equipped Kitchen, Service Room or Office with full Bathroom and exterior entrance, Pool.

\*\*\* In the Top floor there are 2 New lofts of 60 meters each one, fully equipped with air, fans, including kitchen, concrete living room and dining room, 1 full bathroom, modern and tasteful decoration, ideal for business, to rent for short or long stays, ideal for retirees or foreigners who come to Merida for seasons.

Separate entrance.

\*\*\* Parking for more than 6 cars  
\*\*\* Electric gate  
\*\*\* 2 covered terraces  
\*\*\* Laundry area  
\*\*\* Pool of 5 meters2

The house is 15 years old, the lofts are 8 years old and it was remodeled 4 years ago.

### Property description

Beautiful fully furnished and equipped house in Progreso with spectacular ocean views. Just one block from the beach and one block from the bus route.  
Located on the corner and just a few blocks from the Malecon, in a residential area of Progreso with an American and Canadian community.  
  
FEATURES  
• 3 floors  
• Lot 180m2= 9 x 20m  
• Construction 242m2  
• 6 years  
  
GROUND FLOOR  
\* Two-car garage with electric gate.  
\* Storage  
\* Washing area. (Includes washing machine)  
\* Covered terrace  
\* Pool  
  
FIRST FLOOR  
  
\* Living room  
\* Dining room with table and chairs  
\* Equipped kitchen (includes refrigerator and stove) with granite countertop.  
\* Half bath  
\* Terrace overlooking the pool  
  
SECOND FLOOR  
  
\* 2 bedrooms each with bathroom and closet (includes furniture)  
\* Terrace overlooking the pool  
  
THIRD FLOOR  
\* Spectacular terrace with sea view.  
  
  
\- Stationary Gas Tank  
\- Water heater  
\- Tinaco  
\- Water system with cistern, hydro-pneumatic equipment  
\- Well with Submersible Pump for Water Pressure in the Pool  
\- High-efficiency air conditioners, fans and curtains  
\- All furniture and equipment included  
  
When you don't occupy it, it has a large income to rent on Airbnb

### Property description

Mayan World Real Estate presents "MIRAMAR APARTMENT, 2 BEDROOMS, 2.5 BATHROOMS, FULLY FURNISHED AND EQUIPPED" in Chicxulub, Yucatán.  
  
Chicxulub is located 30 km from Mérida.  
  
In this beautiful port, the main economic activity is fishing; however, it is a tradition for Chicxulub to welcome local and international vacationers during Easter, summer and winter season, making it a major tourist attraction in the region.  
  
The main avenue, which connects to the port of Progreso, features restaurants and food shops, many of which open during the holiday season, along with a nightclub and bar area.  
  
Its beaches have white sand, are shallow, and have calm waves with no currents, making it an ideal place to practice various water sports such as windsurfing, kayaking, sailing, swimming, paddleboarding, and many others.  
  
FEATURES  
  
This condominium is located just a 3-minute walk from a beautiful sandy beach in a quiet, entirely residential area.  
  
Only 18 apartments with a central pool.  
  
Ground Floor Apartment with Private Pool and 3 Gardens  
  
Only 4 years old  
  
Monthly Maintenance Fee: $2,200 pesos. Annual Property Tax: $1,200 pesos  
  
Open Concept

\*\*\* Guest Bedroom with queen-size bed and access to the outside.  
  
\*\*\* Each bedroom has complete closets, ceiling fans, and air conditioning.  
  
\*\*\* Storage Unit: 3.05 m²  
\*\*\* 1 Private Parking Lot  
  
\*\*\* Fully furnished and equipped.  
  
Common Areas:  
  
\*\*\* Large swimming pool with lounge chairs  
\*\*\* 2 Washers/dryers  
\*\*\* Grill  
\*\*\* Beautiful gardens with lush vegetation

"Mayan World Real Estate presents ""BRAND NEW HOUSES IN GATED COMMUNITY"" in the North of Merida.

### Property description

Mayan World Real Estate presents “CASA DEL PARQUE” in El Prado de Chuburna Neighbornhood.

Chuburna de Hidalgo is one of the most traditional and historic neighborhoods in Merida. Located in the north of the city, its name comes from two Mayan words "Chubul Naah" which translates as The House of Yellow Cotton.

In this emblematic urban area you will find the main church, an old henequen area, the market and the former police and communal houses, which still maintain part of their original essence when it was still a small town.

### Property description

Mayan World Real Estate presents "HOUSE UNDER REMODELING, FINISH IT AS YOU LIKE".

This property is located between the San Cristobal Park and the Pedro Infante Park. 

The San Cristobal neighborhood is the only one that housed the five cultures that marked the origin of our society: Maya, Hispanic, Mexica, mestizo and Arab.

Nowadays, in the San Cristóbal neighborhood you can find the City Museum, a cultural element of great relevance in Mérida; you can locate what was the Federal Post Office, the Lucas de Gálvez market, San Benito and the craft market.

Park in honor of Pedro Infante, Mexican actor and singer, in front of the place where he lost his life in a plane crash more than 60 years ago. The place has a stage, children's play area, parking, picnic area and a bench with the monument to the Idol of Mexico.

The Santa Ana neighborhood, in the Historic Center of the City, includes the Church, the Park and the Santa Ana Market. It is very quiet to spend a pleasant time.

It is a micro world where shops, cafes and art galleries open around the ancient walls of the temple.  The abundant green areas of the park alternate with the old mansions in the area, which little by little are rehabilitated by new inhabitants who have rediscovered the charm of life in the Historic Center of Mérida.

Mayan World Real Estate presents "COSTA CABAÑAS LOT"  in Santa Clara, Yucatan.

Belonging to a Sustainable Community with the perfect balance between BEACH and NATURE is possible in Costa Cabaña, its multiple amenities, eco-tourism and green areas will make you connect with yourself, living a unique experience where you can find peace and relaxation.

Costa Cabaña has a total area of 39 hectares, with a privileged location, 55 minutes from the city of Merida and only 5 minutes from the beautiful beaches of Santa Clara.

As part of the amenities and differentiators of Costa Cabaña you will be able to enjoy your relaxation areas in our clubhouse with a pool cenote type, as well as areas to eat, do yoga, parks, etc.

North-South orientation of lots, Endemic trees in front of each lot, Amenity area at the center of the development, Planned roads with green roundabouts, Bike path protected by trees, Architectural projects included, Ecotourism Center that reduces maintenance fees, Up to 6 lots in 1 construction.

### Property description

Mayan World Real Estate presents "HACIENDA-STYLE HOUSE IN THE SANTIAGO NEIGHBORHOOD" Downtown Merida, Yucatan

The Santiago neighborhood is located west of the historic center in the City of Merida, Yucatan. It is one of the oldest neighborhoods in the city.

It is a favorite among both locals and visitors. It features a park full of tradition and memories, a market steeped in Yucatecan cuisine, and is just steps away from the Centenario Zoo and the Natural History Museum.

This property is a stunning, remodeled, four-bedroom, 18th-century hacienda-style colonial house, carefully designed with the perfect blend of modernity and history.

FEATURES

2-Story House  
483 sq m lot (25 m x 18.80 m)

DOWNSTAIRS

\*\*\* Covered Garage for 1 car  
\*\*\* Exterior entrance Hall  
\*\*\* Living Room  
\*\*\* Guest Bathroom  
\*\*\* Dining Room  
\*\*\* Talavera Kitchen with dishwasher  
\*\*\* Covered Terrace with Dining Area  
\*\*\* Pool and Garden Area  
\*\*\* 2 Master Suites with Bathroom and walk-in closet each  
\*\*\* 1 Bedroom  
\*\*\* Secret jacuzzi area  

UPSTAIRS

\*\*\* 1 Suite with Bathroom and Dressing Room  
\*\*\* Terrace

Features luxury finishes, pasta tiles, original high ceilings with railings and wooden beams, masonry walls, ceiling fans, air conditioners, 22 solar panels, a laundry center, a water softener, a pressurized water system, and a pool with a filtration system and a lower area children's play area, poolside pergola, colorful mural in the pool area by local artist Carlos Hartazgo.

Furniture and appliances included.

### Property description

Mayan World Real Estate presents **“CASA REYNA”** in the San Sebastian area, in the Center of Merida, Yucatan.

The San Sebastian neighborhood is part of the second generation neighborhoods in the city of Merida along with the neighborhoods of La Mejorada and Santa Ana.

San Sebastian, named Magical Neighborhood in July 2023 along with Xcalachén and the Ermita de Santa Isabel, is the only neighborhood that preserves its traditional festival with a vaquería, fireworks, many people socializing in commemoration of the patron saint of the place and in the month of October, the Mucbipollo Fair.

**FEATURES**

Beautiful one-story Colonial House. Just 2 blocks from La Ermita.

Lot  Size 210m2

Construction Size 92m2

\*\*\* Hall

\*\*\* Living Room

\*\*\* Dining Room

\*\*\* Kitchen with Pantry Area

\*\*\* Pool

\*\*\* Garden

\*\*\* 2 Bedrooms

\*\*\* 2 Full Bathrooms

\*\*\* Laundry Room

Equipped with Air Conditioners, Washing Machine, Refrigerator, Stove.

Bedrooms with closets and Bathrooms with furniture.

Kitchen equipped with drawers.

### Property description

Mayan World Real Estate proudly presents "EXTRAORDINARILY DESIGNED BEACH HOME" in Chelem Puerto.

We welcome you to experience an extraordinarily designed beach home; the perfect combination of luxury living and easy maintenance. Located between Chelem and Chuburna, on the north coast of the Yucatan Peninsula, this home is steps from the Gulf waters; just 10 minutes from the port of Progreso; 30 minutes from the historical City of Mérida and 45 minutes from Merida International Airport.

The features of this beautiful home are countless and unlike anything you will find in the area. Every detail has been carefully considered, and the result is an ideal combination colors, textures and materials. Whether you plan to live at the beach permanently or enjoy short stays throughout the year, this turn-key home offers every desired modern convenience - no expense has been spared. 

The features of this home include:

A well-equipped kitchen with built-in European appliances (including a Coffee System for a perfect cappuccino), an oversized kitchen island with Quartz countertops and plenty of windows allowing for impressive views of the front and center courtyards.

The master retreat awaits upstairs on the second level and includes his and hers vanities, a built-in armoire, walk-in closet and a magnificent circular shower with a luxurious Hansgrohe shower system. Sliding glass doors open to a wrap-around terrace where you can enjoy the gulf breezes or watch the setting sun.

A generously sized guest bedroom is located on the ground floor of the main house and offers a private ensuite.

Guests will be delighted by the private casita with a bedroom, full bath, kitchen and living area. The casita offers homeowners the flexibility to have family or friends visit while maintaining privacy in the main house or offers the ability to earn extra income with vacation rental potential or a home for on-site caretakers.

With so many beautiful days here in the Yucatan, outdoor living is the key, and this home offers a gorgeous 60,000 liter, fully automated “Pentair” pool finished in shimmering blue Onix mosaics. Designed with in-pool loungers, tables and umbrellas this can be the perfect place to while-away a Yucatan afternoon.

For additional outdoor living, multiple terraces can be found throughout this property, including the First Floor, the Roof Top (which provides views of both the Gulf and the Ria), the Casita and a Front Courtyard terrace surrounded by lush tropical plants. 

This one-of-a-kind home offers 44 solar panels, a whole house reverse osmosis water system (for clean and drinkable water out of any tap on the property), air conditioning throughout, a BBQ area, two storage bodegas, a dedicated mechanical room and a fully enclosed, climate-controlled garage with commercial roll-up door.

Also includes a 2022 Kia Sportage car

The list of features for this home are too numerous to mention here but can be provided to the discerning buyer who understands and appreciates a home of this quality.

### Property description

Mayan World Real Estate proudly presents "BEAUTIFUL AND COZY TURN KEY HOUSE IN CHUBURNA" EXCELLENT CONDITIONS"  
Chuburna is a little place full of swings in the middle of the turquoise blue sea of Puerto Progreso, considered one of the most beautiful destinations because it joins the white dunes of soft sand that surround the area.  
Located just 45 minutes from Merida, this fishing town has one of the most special and secret beaches in Yucatan.  
FEATURES  
One Storey  
The property has 2 entrances (One on each street)  
Includes a Casita in the Back Yard  
COMPLETELY RENOVATED  
Lot Size 501.02m2

OPEN CONCEPT  
\*\*\* Living Room

\*\*\* 2 Bedrooms  
\*\*\* 1 Full Bathroom  
\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\* Casita with separate Bedroom, Kitchenette, Bathroom and spectacular covered Terrace on the 2ndo. floor (Completed 2019) New Septic installed, Palapa built above Casita, with electrical run outdoor living space.  
NEW CONSTRUCTION: Pool, Front Porch and Propery Walls.  
Caracteristics:  
19 Solar panels, all new wiring (imported the wiring from Canada and installed by homeowner to Canadian electric code), all new pressurized plumbing for pressurized water system and all new drain lines, water softening system, Two wells dug (one for water and one drain well for pool), Two new septics installed, Landscaping blocks and raised garden beds installed, Both bathrooms built, Roof extension (for generator), Installation of back up generator and dedicated 500-liter propane tank, New gas lines for interconnection of 500ltr tank for generator and home and outdoor grill and outdoor stove.  
Features of Note  
6 air conditioning units, Highspeed internet with fibre optic cable, Electric hot water tanks (three) all with timers or on off controls. No city water – well water only. Lots of storage spaces on property.

### Property description

Mayan World Real Estate presents **"NICE 4 TOWN HOUSES"** Near the Beach.

The Port of Chelem, Yucatán is just 9 kilometers west of Puerto Progreso, as well as 45 kilometers north of Mérida Blanca.

One of the main activities to do in Chelem, Yucatán, is without a doubt enjoying its beautiful beaches, the waves, the sun and its soft sand. At dusk or dawn, walking along the seashore is one of the best things you can do, and at dusk, you can spend a pleasant time at the fair that is set up in this small port. In the mornings, don't miss the opportunity to visit its market, where in addition to fresh fruits and vegetables, there are small establishments that offer exquisite dishes, as well as stalls where they sell Yucatan crafts.Likewise, there is a place called La Ría de Chelem that you can access through tours at affordable prices.

The project is a unique and very well located development located in the heart of Chelem Beach, a project that offers owners a high return on investment and high capital gain.

### Property description

Mayan World Real Estate presents "CASA GAVIOTA" 2 Blocks from the Beach in Chicxulub Puerto.

In this beautiful port, the main economic activity is fishing, however, it is a tradition for Chicxulub to receive local and foreign vacationers during Easter and the summer season, which is why it has become an important tourist attraction in the region.

The main avenue that connects with the port of Progreso has restaurants and food stores, stores that open up during the holiday season along with the area of ​​clubs and bars.

An important activity is the port fair that is set up in the main park and can be enjoyed by the family. It has mechanical games, food stands and sales of various products of interest. You can also go to the pier very early to fish with your friends or family. Don't forget to bring your bait!!

1 Storey

Open Concept

\*\*\* Solar panels

\*\*\* Plus electricity and internet.

Mayan World Real Estate presents **"VILLA FLAMINGOS"** one block from the beach in Chicxulub Puerto, Yucatan.

Just eight kilometers from Progreso is the port of Chicxulub, famous for the fall of a huge meteorite that wiped out the dinosaurs 65 million years ago.

On the main avenue, which connects this port to Progreso, you will find a wide variety of restaurants for all tastes.

This port has all the services you need to enjoy your stay, such as supermarkets, pharmacies, local bakeries, and more.

Fully furnished, 3-story villa one block from the beach

\*\*\* Parking for one car  
\*\*\* Living room with bay window  
\*\*\* Dining room with bay window  
\*\*\* Kitchen with breakfast bar  
\*\*\* Guest bathroom  
\*\*\* Pool  
\*\*\* Garden

\*\*\* Master bedroom with full bathroom and closet  
\*\*\* Secondary bedroom with double bunk bed  
\*\*\* Full bathroom

**LEVEL 3**

\*\*\* Bedroom with single bunk bed  
\*\*\* Spacious terrace with synthetic grass, street view  
\*\*\* Bathtub with pergola and open area

**Includes**

\*\*\* Screened windows  
\*\*\* Air conditioning  
\*\*\* Curtains in dining room and bedrooms  
\*\*\* Solar panel system  
\*\*\* Internet service  
\*\*\* Hot water service  
\*\*\* Plateau Granite countertops in kitchen  
\*\*\* 60x60 cm ceramic tile flooring

Mayan World Real Estate presents **"VILLA TORTUGA"** one block from the beach in Chicxulub Puerto, Yucatan.

Just eight kilometers from Progreso is the port of Chicxulub, famous for the fall of a huge meteorite that wiped out the dinosaurs 65 million years ago.

On the main avenue, which connects this port to Progreso, you will find a wide variety of restaurants for all tastes.

This port has all the services you need to enjoy your stay, such as supermarkets, pharmacies, local bakeries, and more.

This port has all the services necessary to enjoy your stay, such as grocery stores, pharmacies, local bakeries and more.

UPSTAIRS

### Property description

Mayan World Presents "Celestun Paradise".  Some Properties need Introductions, this one speaks for Itself.

The owner/builder of this exceptional home was a developer/builder in Canada. He has brought the high Canadian quality of his trade to Celestun and it is reflected in this, his family home. No expense was spared and it shows.   
All the cement was mixed to the builders high standards. All the reinforcing re bar is twice coated in high quality anti-corrosive. All the electric wire is of a thicker gauge than code requires. The quality of materials you cannot see, you can feel in the sturdiness of the home. A 3-mt thick x 3-mt deep storm wall, on the beach side, provides the ultimate protection from storm tides (rare on this side of the Yucatan Peninsula).   
This large beach front villa perfectly accommodates this spacious, sunny, open floor plan, 2-story home. Only 1.7 km north of Celestun. The home boasts 3-bedrooms, 5-baths, an office, laundry, bar, an extensive patio and a considerable 2nd floor patio that vibrates with hummingbirds and looks to the sea. The commodious 3-car garage, shop and bodega provide room for all your favorite toys.   
The entire house is air conditioned with inverter type units, including the shop. A new 110/220 electric service and 62 solar panels provide the juice to keep the place humming. But just in case you have an outage, the 11,000-watt gas generator will keep your lights on, the refrigerators cool and maintain a room or two with a/c. It will also keep the house alarm/detection system and the perimeter electric sentry operating to keep out unwanted guests.

Mayan World Real Estate presents "RESIDENTIAL KANTARA LOT" in Dzidzilche neighborhood.

The name (Dzidzilché) means honey tree in Yucatec Mayan languaje, it is located 26 kilometers north of the city of Mérida. Near the highway to Progreso

Kantára Residencial, is a development that includes each of the stages of the life cycle, since it offers well-defined spaces and a well-planned urbanization; A clubhouse and five theme parks designed for each of them: infancy, childhood, youth and adulthood; With this becoming the best long-term housing alternative.

  
FEATURES

\*\*\* Flat Land with 671mt2 ready to build. Totally urbanized with gas, electricity and water installations, parking place for visitors.

\*\*\* Maintenance is paid until February 2021.

AMENITIES

\*\*\* It has 5 theme parks with Banks, Wi-Fi and Books.  
\*\*\* 200 linear meters of perimeter wall of chaká trees.  
\*\*\* Setting with extensive vegetation.  
\*\*\* Lake with tents and marine vegetation.  
\*\*\* Picnic area with grills.  
\*\*\* Organic nursery.  
\*\*\* Treehouse.  
\*\*\* Volcano recreational area.  
\*\*\* Large pool area and wading pool.  
\*\*\* Semi-Olympic swimming channel of 5 × 20 m with 2 lanes.  
\*\*\* Paddle tennis court and multipurpose courts: basketball, volleyball and soccer.  
\*\*\* Play areas for children from 4 to 7 years old.  
\*\*\* 1,000 m2 with contemplative benches and games.  
\*\*\* Game's zone  
\*\*\* 600 m2 of covered area.  
\*\*\* 200 m2 of covered sunbathing area overlooking the swimming pools (sunbathing area with wooden deck).  
\*\*\* Luxury gym equipped with a yoga area, heated and overlooking the green areas.  
\*\*\* Lockers and showers area.  
\*\*\* Heated bathrooms and dressing rooms.  
\*\*\* Recreation area with television.  
\*\*\* Heated kitchen, equipped with quartz countertops, mahogany drawers and drawers.

### Property description

Mayan World Real Estate presents **"BRAND NEW HOME IN GARCIA GINERES"**

García Ginerés is the name of a traditional, high-value neighborhood in Mérida.  
This neighborhood is known for its history, family atmosphere, and proximity to iconic sites such as Parque de las Américas and Paseo de Montejo.

Parque de las Americas is a jewel of the Neo-Mayan architectural style, as well as a forum for multiple spaces and different types of activities: a playground, a library, several fountains and monuments, among other elements, are located throughout the four blocks it encompasses.

This property is brand new, designed and built to maintain excellent ventilation, lighting, and comfort.

The house features luxury finishes: porcelain tile floors, marble in the bathrooms, tempered glass partitions, and granite countertops in the kitchen. Ceilings range from 3.00 m to 4.50 m in the living and dining rooms.

**FEATURES**

DOWNSTAIRS

\*\*\* Parking for 2 Cars  
\*\*\* Open Kitchen with granite countertops  
\*\*\* Double-height Living/Dining Room  
\*\*\* Secondary Bedroom with shared Bathroom  
\*\*\* Interior Patio for greater ventilation and natural light  
\*\*\* Garden with Pool  
\*\*\* Laundry area

Beautiful residence in the best location in the North of Mérida.

Cabo Norte is a planned community with a privileged location, north of Mérida, behind the most beautiful shopping center in the city, surrounded by schools, gyms and supermarkets.

The residential has an unmatched exterior design. It also has a central clubhouse with excellent amenities, 4 lakes where you can do different activities, a 5 km trail for long walks, pet park, aqua park, baby park, fitness start, among others.

\*\*\* 1 Secondary Bedroom with walk in closet and full Bathroom
